versions.changelog:
feishu-task-control 1.0.1

- Clarified guidance and response flow for managing background tasks in Feishu chats.
- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md with examples and safety notes.
- Detailed how to resolve task targets (by id, label, or summary) and handle ambiguous cases.
- Added instructions to avoid exposing internal details in user replies.
- Emphasized concise, explicit replies and appropriate handling of task control intents.
